messages:
rachel: FYI CI finished but deploybot failed the publish to eu-ecr during the post-attach provenance check. Looks like an annotation mismatch between cosign and ECR gate. :thinking:

deploy-bot: automated: Publish attempt for eu-ecr.redwood/service-b@sha256:7f4d2c blocked: provenance lint error: annotation 'org.redwood.kms-region' expected 'eu-west-1' but got ''. Rejecting manifest. See deploy logs: /logs/deploy/1747408888

jon: that's odd. our build config writes kms-region from the build matrix. Could be a race where replication metadata wasn't ready for the ECR regional gate.

rachel: log excerpt: ```ECR validation: missing annotation org.redwood.kms-region
attest: cosign: signature present
metadata: build_id=ci-2026-03-21-01, arch=amd64, kms_key=projects/redwood/keys/eu```

luis: can we re-run the attestation check manually, or do we need a republish?

emily: if replication lag caused the annotation to be blank, republishing the same digest won't help because push will be skipped. We should pin the staging route to the previous digest for the release window while we investigate.

release-manager: Decision: pin staging traffic to digest sha256:aa11bb for the release window. Stop auto-promotes for job=service-b-nightly. We will schedule a manual republish to correct metadata and then promote when ready.

jon: commands I'll run: `deploybot lock job=service-b-nightly reason="provenance annotation missing"` and `deploybot pin route=staging/service-b digest=sha256:aa11bb note="pin during metadata recovery"`

deploy-bot: automated: Lock applied for job=service-b-nightly by jon. Auto-promote disabled.

deploy-bot: automated: Route staging/service-b pinned to sha256:aa11bb by jon. Note: pin expires in 24h unless extended.

luis: I'll open a support ticket with ECR to check regional replication delays and KMS annotation propagation. Tagging infra oncall.

emily: release notes: add line "Staging held; pinned to previous digest due to image metadata failure during EU publish; manual republish pending."

rachel: trying a local re-run of the publishing step with explicit annotation injection to force a new manifest: `./scripts/publish-image --annotate org.redwood.kms-region=eu-west-1 --force`

deploy-bot: automated: Publish received. Validation failed: manifest duplicate skipped by registry when forcing identical digest. Manual republish resulted in no-op.

jon: ok, that confirms republish won't create a new digest. We'll need to rebuild with a new tag and correct annotations, then run cosign and attestation.

luis: plan: 1) temporary pin (done). 2) rebuild with deterministic build_id suffix to create new digest + inject annotation. 3) run cosign, attest, then promote after canary. 4) if rebuild delayed > 90m, notify SRE and customers.

emily: rollback plan: if canary error budget crosses threshold or downstream third-party tests fail, we'll route traffic back to canary baseline and abort promote. Notify release channel.

release-manager: I'll update the change window: hold until resolved, pinned digest noted, working with infra to confirm KMS propagation. I'll also draft the brief to customers.

rachel: PR opened to ensure our image tool always writes org.redwood.kms-region from build metadata and to add an integration lint that runs before publish. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/build-tools/pull/128 :rocket:

jon: rebuild started. ETA ~25m. Will post new digest when available.

deploy-bot: automated: New image published to eu-ecr.redwood/service-b@sha256:c3d9fa. Validation passed. Promotion still locked; manual promote required.

luis: starting manual canary 5% -> 15m. Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood/services/service-b/canary

emily: will hold on release notes until canary stable for 10m. Also adding the incident link for postmortem: https://incidents.redwood/2026-03-21-ecr-annotation

release-manager: Canary healthy at +12m. Proceeding to full promote across staging. Removing pin and unlocking job.

jon: commands: `deploybot unpin route=staging/service-b` and `deploybot unlock job=service-b-nightly`

deploy-bot: automated: Route staging/service-b unpinned by jon. Job service-b-nightly unlocked.

emily: updating release notes and change log with pin history and recovery steps.

luis: follow-up: add metric to detect missing provenance annotations pre-publish so we fail earlier in CI. Creating ticket INF-472.

rachel: thanks team. Closing thread once release notes published."
